summary.blockerDetail: The main bottleneck for me this week is the AI tool credits. At the start of the week—Monday to Wednesday—many editors are actively using AI, which quickly depletes the available credits. I work in a timezone where most people have already finished their editing for the day, so by the time I start, platforms are already out of credits. This means I have to wait until the evening here (which is morning in the UK) to refill the credits. When I try to work during peak hours—when everyone else is using the platforms—AI generation becomes slow because many are using it.

- 2.7.26 | GO2 | DCO1 > 2.2.26_MTRX_PQ10_M2
- 2.7.26 | GO2 | DCO1 > 2.5.26_MTRX_PQ10_M3
